name: @cf-dam/agent
description: The cf-dam NAS agent: indexes photos where they are and sends metadata and previews to cf-dam.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/agent.mjs --external:sharp --external:exiftool-vendored --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
